method: New code-drawn high-resolution text, shapes and colour blocks from exact U170 official photographs. Direct PNG rasterization; no product photograph pixels cropped, projected, sampled or enlarged. Only final ordinary PNGs distributed.

files.target: LoRaE220-920 S1 fixed deck with two genuine slider slots

limitations: Typography, colors and registration are appearance estimates, with no exhaustive browser review.
Front LoRa920 and public certification001-P01730, rear LoRaE220-JP920MHz/model/mode/UART and S1ON1/2 printed legends follow exact own U170 photos. No private serial/QR/barcode invented.
Static rear M0/M1 mode print retained from photograph; official table/ON-to-logic note ambiguity reported as feedback00ea6ae3dfc5419192d9e28306a0bdbe; no mode logic implemented.
Printed layers target genuine physical shell/deck surfaces and preserve native apertures and all physical attributes/index/matrixWorld when disabled.
Source photographs, originals, vectors, generators and source tables are excluded. Product names, printed designs and trademarks retain their respective rights.
